ops.title: 2026-07-23 hook outage: schema fences without migrations bricked dispatch after 12.11.0→12.14.0 upgrade
ops.body: Machine-wide hook outage after upgrading Captain Hook.app 12.11.0→12.14.0 (autobump shipped 12.12–12.14 in one day; cask upgrade is manual). Two distinct fail-fast schema fences fired against durable state written by the old stack. (1) FATAL: the daemonkit-based host refused to start — 'proc: unsupported durable process record schema: keyed store bucket "stop-consumed" is missing' loading ~/Library/Caches/captain-hook/host-v1/workers.json (binary keyed store from 12.11.0). Every 'capt-hookd run' client then queued on start.lock and died with 'acquire host start lock: context deadline exceeded' — all hooks in all repos failed non-blocking. Fix: archived workers.json (kept as workers.json.12.11.0-schema.bak beside it); serve came up in ~5s and end-to-end dispatch verified exit 0. (2) NON-FATAL: capt-hook's decision writer drops every ledger write — cc_transcript decision_store 'decisions schema version 0, want exactly 1' against ~/.cc-transcript/decisions.db (4.5MB, tables decisions + dispatch_heartbeats, PRAGMA user_version=0). open_decisions_sqlite only auto-creates on an EMPTY db; v0-with-data is refused, no migration exists, and the resident cc-review daemon (~/.cc-review/v1/bin, uptime 19h) still holds and writes the v0 db — cross-product skew, so archiving it under a live cc-review would split-brain. Also observed in capt-hookd.log: sqlite3.ProgrammingError cross-thread use of the wn lexicon connection in captain_hook/signals/nlp.py lemmas(). Backlog tasks filed for all three.
